extensionSha256Method: sha256 of a sha256sum listing of every file under extension/, paths relative to it and sorted bytewise; from the repository root: cd extension && find . -type f -printf '%P\n' | LC_ALL=C sort | xargs sha256sum | sha256sum
method: Actual Chromium DOM/media/IntersectionObserver in an isolated JavaScript world; extension runtime/storage APIs and URL/navigation are simulated. Pages are about:blank fixtures: no navigation or policy override. No installed extension, no LinkedIn login, no DNR browser-engine test. Hidden/PiP/fullscreen/BFCache states simulated.

tests.name: All posts/Promoted text retained, nested cards deduplicated, native network APIs unchanged
Only far-away cards receive actual content-visibility:auto; browser find can find their text
Textareas, rich editors and newly typed drafts remain intact and uncontained
A card whose only input is hidden is still deferred; a visible input still excludes it
Live option toggles and master switch restore attributes/CSS without a reload
Scrolling reactivates cards, preserves fixture document height and does not delete old posts
Large insertion bursts are handled; references to site-removed cards are released
Messaging pages do not receive feed DOM or media interventions
Simulated route/popstate changes restore and reapply without reinjection
Late-arriving main/feed containers are discovered
Replacing the main container releases old annotations and tracks only the new feed
Real visible video playback is allowed; source/autoplay/preload/volume stay unchanged
Real offscreen video playback is paused; live disable permits playback
Simulated hidden-tab state pauses real video and return does not autoplay
Simulated PiP/fullscreen state protects real video; leaving protected state reapplies policy
Fixture execution does not read text/input/cookies, request an external resource or expose isolated globals
Resize/reflow maintains fixture height after recomputing deferred-card placeholders
Resize events are debounced: one remeasure after the burst settles
Simulated pagehide/BFCache pageshow cleans up and reinitializes
Interaction attribute changes remove containment before an editor is used
Repeated on/off cycles do not duplicate tracked cards or lose DOM nodes
Removed feed trees are released even while the simulated tab remains hidden
An invalidated extension context (disabled/removed/reloaded) stops the left-over script and clears its annotations
A burst of attribute changes above the feed causes a bounded number of root rescans and none off the feed
Pre-existing custom CSS property is restored, rather than overwriting unrelated page state
A long feed gets a reload notice outside the feed; only a click reloads, and Later snoozes it
The notice follows its setting and the master switch, stays off other pages and leaves with an orphaned script
Class changes are watched inside the feed only once cards are known
Modern mainFeed without a main element detects component-key post wrappers
An empty first main does not hide cards in a later main
Hidden main trees are excluded during root selection
A container with zero supported posts reports unrecognized, not success
List-item fallback requires the known mainFeed and a post-body marker
Nested legacy markers inside modern cards are not double-counted
A late mainFeed outside an empty main is discovered automatically
Adding or removing role during hydration updates detection without new nodes
Legacy class-marker hydration and removal also update the card registry

Replacing a modern feed with a legacy root releases all old card references
Modern cards preserve draft editors and cleanly remove optimization annotations
Explicit diagnostics use only fixed enums and counts without reading page text or values

English/Italian popup, live selector, persistence and narrow-layout screenshots

Zero-post UI, sanitized report, clipboard fallback, translation and report cleanup

While the page has not answered, the popup says it is checking, in both languages
